$comment: DISTRIBUTION LOG. One row per act of publishing. Not a CRM: nine fields, no contacts, no pipeline, no personal data.
status: planned -> published | skipped | blocked. Fill date and result AFTER publishing; never before.
attribution is null where the channel carries no tracked link on purpose (community, outreach). That is a decision, not a gap -- see README.md section 5.
Rows for days 1-14 were DERIVED from marketing/content/register.json rather than typed, so the two cannot disagree.
Validated by `pnpm check:distribution`, which re-derives every field from the content register and the site routes and fails on any drift.
Append rows for days 15-30 when those days are reached. This file is a log, not a plan: marketing/content/calendar.md is the schedule.

rowShape.date: YYYY-MM-DD, the day it actually went out. null while planned
rowShape.day: day offset from marketing/content/calendar.md, or null for opportunistic work
rowShape.channel: linkedin | x | devto | hashnode | github | community | outreach
rowShape.destination: a route that exists in apps/web/src/app, or null
rowShape.icpHypothesis: p1 | p2 | neutral. Which MESSAGE was tested, never who the reader is (analytics.md section 9)
rowShape.pillar: a | b | c | d | e | f | g, from CONTENT-PILLARS.md
rowShape.attribution: the utm quartet, or null where the channel carries no tracked link by design
rowShape.result: free text, written after. Absolute counts only until analytics.md section 10's baseline window closes

$notYetRoutes: Routes named in the distribution documents BECAUSE they do not exist yet. /blog is the seo.md decision: no blog until three articles have run off-site and one shows traffic. Anything else naming a missing route is a defect.

rows.metricToWatch: whether kx_source=x produces any session at all
kx_p1_c_manifest vs kx_p2_a_drift — the P1/P2 comparison starts here

rows.metricToWatch: replies; the most quotable asset in week 1

rows.secondary: hashnode, canonical_url pointing at the dev.to article. Optional, after dev.to indexes
rows.communityReuse: COM-001 derives from it — not before day 10
rows.metricToWatch: Qualified Evaluation of devto sessions against linkedin, as counts
